##: addons/ holds both bundled and user-installed add-ons; persist it and merge new bundled files without overwriting (Scoop#2185).
Stage via pre_install; addons.original/ is an internal persist_data detail (Scoop#2897), not a manifest contract.
Add-ons are updated independently by the Add-ons updater, so never overwrite existing files.
description: A tabbed file manager with Add-on support.
pre_install: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $bundled = Join-Path $dir 'addons'; $stage = Join-Path $persist_dir ('addons.bundled-' + $version); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $bundled) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $persist_dir -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stage) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }; Move-Item -LiteralPath $bundled -Destination $stage -ErrorAction Stop }
post_install: $src = Join-Path $persist_dir ('addons.bundled-' + $version); $dst = Join-Path $dir 'addons'; if (Test-Path $src) { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $src -Recurse -File | ForEach-Object { $to = Join-Path $dst $_.FullName.Substring($src.Length).TrimStart('\'); if (-not (Test-Path $to)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $to -Parent) -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $to } }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $src -Recurse -Force }
